04 · Protection

Ceramic coating

A ceramic coating is a liquid that bonds to the paint and cures into a hard, glossy, water-repelling layer. It makes the car easier to keep clean and protects the finish for far longer than a wax.

The coating Rebel currently uses gives up to 24 months of protection. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: coating product name, price or from-price, and how long the job takes]

See a recent ceramic coating job: Ford Puma

Get a ceramic coating quote

What a coating does

  • Water and dirt run off more easily, so the car stays cleaner for longer
  • Washing is quicker and gentler
  • Adds depth and gloss to well-prepared paint
  • Resists bird droppings, traffic film and UV for longer than wax or sealant

What it doesn't do

  • It doesn't make the paint scratch-proof
  • It won't stop stone chips
  • It won't hide swirls. It locks in whatever is underneath, which is why paint is usually polished first.
  • It doesn't mean the car never needs washing

Wax, sealant or coating?

How wax, sealant and ceramic coating compare
Typically lastsPreparation needed
WaxWeeksA clean car
SealantMonthsA clean car
Ceramic coatingYears, depending on the product and how the car is washedFull decontamination and usually polishing

How the paint is prepared

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: Rebel's actual process and product. Typical steps are listed below. Edit them to match.]

  1. Wash and decontaminate A full wash, then iron fallout and tar removed and the paint clayed smooth.
  2. Polish Machine polishing to remove swirls before they're sealed in. See machine polishing.
  3. Panel wipe Polishing oils are removed so the coating can bond to bare paint.
  4. Apply The coating is applied panel by panel and levelled.
  5. Cure The car must be kept dry while the coating cures. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: how long, and the first-wash advice for the product used]

Looking after a coated car

  • Wash with a pH-neutral shampoo and a clean mitt
  • Avoid automatic brush car washes
  • Dry with a clean microfibre towel or air

Regular maintenance washes keep the coating performing. Rebel VIP covers fortnightly or monthly valets at your home.

Ceramic coating questions

Will a ceramic coating stop stone chips and scratches?

No. A coating is far harder than wax but it is a thin layer. It won't stop stone chips, and the car can still be scratched. Paint protection film is the product for chip protection.

Do I still need to wash the car?

Yes. A coated car stays cleaner for longer and is much easier to wash, but it still needs washing. Regular, careful washing is what keeps a coating performing. Rebel VIP can take care of that.

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: conditions needed, e.g. dry weather, covered space, how long the car must stay dry afterwards.]

Does the car need polishing first?

A coating locks in whatever is underneath it, including swirls, so the paint is usually polished first. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: whether polishing is always included or quoted separately.]
